scope: Broad web search for Jean-Pierre Boutros as a sound, recording, mixing, mastering, live, broadcast and sound-design engineer, beyond the artists already listed in the portfolio.
method: English name variants Jean-Pierre Boutros, Jean Pierre Boutros, JeanPierre Boutros, Jean Pierre Botrous and Jean Pierre Botros; Arabic جان بيار بطرس and جان بيير بطرس; French role terms; reverse searches for StudioJPB, Studio JPB and Studio Jean-Pierre Boutros. Original artist uploads, production archives and the UN press release were preferred. Secondary catalogues and reporting remain identified. The owner's two websites were excluded as independent proof.
website_action: Jean-Pierre approved six selected findings, excluded Maher Zain and Between the two Blacks, and authorized publication of all new additions. The five studio entries and one live project were published through HostGator in content release 24ec55e on 3 November 2026; live delivery was verified.

exclusions_and_limits: Same-name academic, political, legal, business and personal-record results were excluded as unrelated; no personal details from those results are retained.
Own-site and self-authored profile copy establish professional web presence but were not counted as independent production evidence.
Other contributors' names and credits are not part of the published public wording.
Compilation appearances and duplicate mirrors of the same release are not additional engineering projects.
Public search is not a complete lifetime discography. Missing searchable credits do not mean no work occurred.
Direct YouTube fetches sometimes returned only a shell or cache miss; indexed original-video descriptions supplied the named credit lines.
Every future portfolio addition must retain the exact personal-versus-studio scope above.
date_note: Original source-review date is retained. Reconciliation records publication decisions and scope, not new source retrievals.
